Speaker: Dana Founder
Host (never attribute their words to the speaker): Sam Host
Source: "Synthetic Interview (test fixture)" (podcast) https://example.com/synthetic-interview
Date said: 2024-03-15 (

claims.quote: We shipped 1,200 F2 robots to paying customers in 2024.
claims.claim: Ferrowind Robotics shipped 1,200 F2 humanoid robots to paying customers in 2024.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Ferrowind shipment disclosures or credible industry reporting show about 1,200 F2 robots delivered to paying customers in 2024.

claims.quote: We shipped 1,200 F2 robots to paying customers in 2024. That's up from about three hundred in 2023.
claims.claim: Ferrowind Robotics shipped about 300 robots to paying customers in 2023.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Ferrowind shipment disclosures or credible industry reporting show roughly 300 robots delivered to paying customers in 2023.

claims.quote: We just finished our first real production line in Reno.
claims.claim: Ferrowind Robotics has finished building its first full production line, in Reno.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Company announcements, permits or local news confirm a completed Ferrowind production line in Reno at the time of the interview.

claims.quote: So I'll say it plainly: we will ship ten thousand F2 robots by the end of 2025, for sure.
claims.claim: Ferrowind Robotics will ship 10,000 F2 humanoid robots by the end of 2025.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Ferrowind shipment figures or credible reporting show at least 10,000 F2 robots shipped to customers by 2025-12-31.

claims.quote: A million home robots by 2027 is not going to happen, not from us and not from anybody else.
claims.claim: Neither Ferrowind Robotics nor any other company will have one million humanoid robots in homes by the end of 2027.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Industry data or credible reporting shows that no company has one million humanoid robots installed in homes as of 2027-12-31.

claims.quote: The F3 will launch at our developer day in March 2026, and the F3 is the first robot we've designed with the home in mind.
claims.claim: Ferrowind Robotics will launch its F3 robot at its developer day in March 2026.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Ferrowind publicly launches the F3 at a developer day held in March 2026, as shown by the event record or news coverage.

claims.quote: I think we'll be cash-flow positive by the second quarter of 2026. Not profitable on a GAAP basis, cash-flow positive.
claims.claim: Ferrowind Robotics will be cash-flow positive, though not necessarily GAAP-profitable, by the end of the second quarter of 2026.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Ferrowind financial statements or credible reporting show positive cash flow for a period ending on or before 2026-06-30.

claims.quote: Every F2 comes with what we call the skills plan. It's a monthly fee per robot.
claims.claim: Ferrowind Robotics sells every F2 robot with a 'skills plan', a monthly per-robot subscription.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Ferrowind pricing pages, contracts or customer reports show a mandatory monthly per-robot skills plan for the F2.

claims.quote: Our second factory, in Monterrey, will probably open by the middle of 2026.
claims.claim: Ferrowind Robotics will open its second factory, in Monterrey, Mexico, by the middle of 2026.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Company announcements or local news show Ferrowind's Monterrey factory open and operating by 2026-06-30.

claims.quote: Half of our revenue will come from outside the United States by the end of 2027, definitely.
claims.claim: Half of Ferrowind Robotics' revenue will come from outside the United States by the end of 2027.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Ferrowind financial disclosures or credible reporting show at least 50% of its revenue coming from outside the United States by 2027-12-31.

claims.quote: I'm confident humanoid robots will be working in at least one major hospital in the US by the end of 2026.
claims.claim: Humanoid robots from any company will be working in at least one major US hospital by the end of 2026.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Credible reporting or hospital announcements show humanoid robots in regular operational use at a major US hospital by 2026-12-31.

claims.quote: Maybe by 2030 you'll be able to buy a home robot for less than ten thousand dollars.
claims.claim: A home robot will be available to buy for less than $10,000 by 2030.
claims.resolutionCriteria: A general-purpose home robot is on sale to consumers at a list price under $10,000 by 2030-12-31.

claims.claim: Ferrowind Robotics will go public in 2027.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Ferrowind shares begin trading on a public stock exchange during 2027.

claims.quote: I think open-sourcing the base models for robots is the right call for safety.
claims.claim: Open-sourcing the base AI models that control robots is the right choice for safety.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Dana Founder continues to argue for open robot base models, and Ferrowind continues to publish its base-model weights.

claims.quote: I'm against a robot tax. Taxing robots is taxing productivity.
claims.claim: Governments should not tax robots that replace workers.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Dana Founder continues to publicly oppose taxes on robots or automation.

claims.quote: If you want to help workers, and we should, fund training and wage insurance directly.
claims.claim: Governments should help workers affected by automation by funding training and wage insurance directly.
claims.resolutionCriteria: Dana Founder continues to advocate direct funding of worker training and wage insurance as the response to automation.
